findings.required: U+2022 once per Unicode scalar, not grapheme or byte; map original byte endpoints to scalar ordinal ×3, inverse hit mapping back to original bytes. Caret/selection/IME underline/scroll all use the masked display geometry.
findings.cui_gap: Input paint and cached hit acquire actual committed/composed text. Existing optional text_geometry cache deep-copies plaintext and caps acquisition at65535bytes; fallback also measures plaintext. No mask/display mapping exists.

findings.required: Masked previous-word target0, next-word targetvalue.length; modified movement/selection/deletion use those edges. Double-click selects entire value; ordinary grapheme editing remains.
findings.cui_gap: Input reducer ignores existing event.click_count and invokes ordinary Unicode-word engine operations. Core click_count already exists, so no event expansion is needed.

findings.required: Copy and Cut disabled when masked, including readonly and context-menu capability. Paste remains editable and validated; reveal restores ordinary copying.
findings.cui_gap: Input reducer invokes clipboard_set for any nonempty selection. No masked capability or control context menu API. Clipboard denial must occur before invoking host callback, not merely reject deletion afterward.

findings.required: Masked alone suppresses accessibility value but does not imply source PasswordInput role. Password/NewPassword content type selects password role and suppresses value even while unmasked. Content type is a hint, not an automatic rendering/validation change. Native hint source is macOS-only.
findings.cui_gap: CUI semantic details lack secret/password purpose; Base exposes numeric UTF8 byte length, not string value. AccessKit phase1 has no text/value implementation and uses generic TEXT_INPUT. Browser semantic mirror is generic textbox. No reusable Input purpose metadata exists.

findings.required: Preedit and composition underline are masked and remapped; model validation sees real values; commit and Undo retain real values. Suppress plaintext presentation/decorations, not composition dispatch.
findings.cui_gap: Composed Input currently paints actual preedit and computes caret from actual value. Native candidate rectangle is already available but follows that actual geometry. Browser invisible textarea temporarily holds host preedit as plaintext and is not a secure password control.

findings.required: Independent reveal flag changes presentation/capabilities only, not document/history. Predicate sees normalized real candidate; checked rejection and host-end cancel keep their contracts.
findings.cui_gap: Mask state/cache/session ownership and failure policy are absent. Large values must not silently fall back to cleartext on mask capacity/allocation/factory errors.

proposal: complete single-line masked Input plus independent Password/NewPassword semantic/host purpose
